zh-CN.title: 上下文裁剪
zh-CN.description: 按需缩短旧的只读工具结果，保留近期消息与原生摘要。

usage.title: 正常进行对话
usage.description: 启用后自动检查长对话中的旧工具输出，不需要打开独立页面或输入额外命令。

usage.title: 达到阈值时自动处理
usage.description: 满足配置的上下文阈值和调用间隔后，裁剪已过时的只读工具结果，保留近期消息和受保护内容。

requirements: 管理员已配置 TypeSafe Jev 服务凭据及触发阈值；处理时会向该服务发送限定范围的对话内容。

en-US.title: Context pruning
en-US.description: Shorten older read-only tool results while preserving recent messages and native summaries.

usage.title: Continue your conversation
usage.description: Once enabled, it automatically checks old tool output in long conversations. No separate page or command is needed.

usage.title: Prune when the threshold is reached
usage.description: After the configured token threshold and call interval, obsolete read-only results are shortened while recent and protected content is retained.

requirements: An administrator must configure TypeSafe Jev credentials and thresholds. Processing sends bounded conversation content to that service.
